theme: Young investor / first-timer: starting early, small amounts, ₹500/month
headline: Begin your investing journey with small steps
body: Starting early with modest amounts builds wealth over time. Consistency matters more than the size of contribution.
caption: Even ₹500 monthly can create meaningful wealth when invested regularly over years. The power of time and discipline transforms small investments into substantial corpus. #StartSmall #InvestEarly #ConsistencyWins #YoungInvestor #WealthBuilding
